evidence_boundary.inference_scope: Twelve registered local scenario groups; no claim about official environment or unseen distributions
evidence_boundary.interval_limitation: Exploratory percentile intervals after checkpoint selection; no correction for selection or multiple comparisons

bootstrap.method: stratified by the twelve scenario groups, resample paired worlds within group

protocol.paired_difference_sign: candidate minus baseline; negative is faster
protocol.cross_initialization_rule: Each of at least two initializations must improve against both its own BC and original C7
